notes.title: Grapple Car Demo Update 1.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]Huge thanks to everyone that has played the demo so far! I'm so happy to hear you are having fun with my game :)[/b]
[/h3][p][i]This patch includes a few community requested features, bug-fixes, and general quality of life improvements.[/i] [/p][p][/p][h1][b]PATCH NOTES:[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b][i]CHANGES:[/i][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved grapple steering consistency[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled right thumb stick click to look behind[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tutorial level set-dressing and added some details[/p][/*][*][p]Add start/finish line decal for better clarity of where laps start[/p][/*][*][p]Added quick restart button[/p][/*][*][p]Added controller rumble, along with an option to disable it in the options for those of you who are not fans[/p][/*][*][p]Added a bug report button to the main menu for you to... uh... report bugs[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b][i]BUG-FIXES:[/i][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug that happened if you paused as you go in the water[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few UI bugs where it showed the wrong amount of car points[/p][/*][*][p]It is no longer possible to submit a lap-time if you haven't finished a full lap (should fix the bottom of the leaderboard being filled with a bunch of 999999 scores)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a couple of PT-BR translation errors[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: INTRODUCING: GRAPPLE CAR!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Grapple Car fans![/b]

I'm Vittorio, a 20 year-old from Brazil. Excited to talk about my first full solo project!


[b]What is this game?[/b]

Grapple car is a game I've been working on and off in my free time for a while now, and now is about time to finally start to share it with the world.

[i]Fast-paced rally-style racing with a grappling hook! [/i]In the final game you'll race around many tracks to complete challenges, earn points to customize your car, and race for a spot at the timed global online leaderboards.


[b]Who is making it?[/b]

Grapple car is a game I've been working on and off in my free time for a while now, and now is about time to finally start to share it with the world. I am developing it almost entirely by myself, with help from friends here and there when I get stuck.

This is a project I am really passionate about and really want to make as good as possible, so please do share any thoughts you have about the game with me, I'd love to hear it!


[b]When is it coming out?[/b]

Honest answer: [i]not sure.[/i]

Current project timeline includes a demo in June's Steam Next fest, but all I can say about the full release is that it will happen at some point during 2026 (hopefully sooner rather than later).
I will post frequent devlogs and progress updates on the game's community feed so you guys are always updated on the game's current progress. I want to be as transparent as possible about the state of the game as I develop it.


[b]How much will it cost?[/b]

The specific price is still to be determined, but grapple car will be a [b]paid game[/b] with a play-time of no more than 3-4 hours. I'll be sure to update the community on the game's price as soon as the project's scope is more defined.



These are just some high-level overview questions and answers, but if there is anything else you want to know about the game, ask away on the comments or just message me directly on LinkedIn, Email or something, I'm sure you can find my content info somewhere.
Thanks for reading my post to the end! I'm truly looking forward to the upcoming months as I continue developing this awesome little game.


Take it easy everyone!
